title: Auto Derive Dark Pdf
description: Stop hand-maintaining six *-dark.tex wrapper files and six duplicate TEMPLATES entries in print/script.ts. Derive each dark PDF automatically at build time from its canonical light .tex file, and let logo/image assets optionally supply a -dark variant by convention.
summary:
Extended auto dark PDF derivation to all `buildPrintDocument` consumers.

- Extracted `compileLightAndDark` used by both `buildPrintDocument` and `compileTemplate`.
- `deriveDarkTexSource` now handles documents without explicit `theme=light` by appending `theme=dark` to `\documentclass` options.
- mit-bestand bericht watch ignores regenerated `*-dark.tex` files.

Verified: mit-bestand zwischenbericht dist now contains both `zwischenbericht.pdf` and `zwischenbericht-dark.pdf`; print test still builds all 12 template PDFs.
